findings.detail: Commentary is 3 sentences but the third sentence is heavily clause-stuffed, violating the 'one declarative claim per sentence' rule.
findings.fixable: Split into two sentences: 'The Fed remains on hold — Core PCE at 3.2% gives no cover for easing.' followed by 'A cut before inflation sustainably approaches 2.5% risks a credibility-damaging re-acceleration.'

findings.detail: Core PCE cited at 3.2% — this figure is not verifiable against the provided data context and is likely stale or incorrect. Current Core PCE YoY is well below 3.2% as of recent BEA releases (running closer to 2.6-2.8% range). If the dashboard KPI tile shows a different value, this is a cross-surface mismatch violating Validator Pass 3e. [critic downgraded]
findings.fixable: Replace '3.2%' with the value shown in the current render cycle's Core PCE KPI tile.

findings.detail: Forward-looking claim — 'risks a credibility-damaging re-acceleration' — is presented as the dashboard's own assessment with no institutional attribution (no Fed, Goldman, CME, etc. cited).
findings.fixable: Attribute explicitly, e.g. 'risks what Fed officials have described as a credibility-damaging re-acceleration' or cite a specific institutional source.

findings.detail: 'sustainably approaches' is mild hedging filler that softens an otherwise declarative sentence.
findings.fixable: Replace 'sustainably approaches 2.5%' with 'returns to 2.5% on a durable basis' or simply 'falls to 2.5%'.
